verses.text: <pb/><t>Mu onwem bu rose nke Sheron,</t> <t>Abum urodi nke ndagwurugwu. <pb/></t>
<t>Dika urodi n'etiti ogwu,</t> <t>Otú a ka eyìm di n'etiti umu-ndinyom. <pb/></t>
<t>Dika osisi apple n'etiti osisi oké ọhia,</t> <t>Otú a ka onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ di n'etiti umu-ndikom.</t> <t>Ǹdò-ya ka m'chọsiworo ike, m'we nọdu ala,</t> <t>Nkpuru-ya tọ-kwa-ra okpo-ọnum utọ.</t>
<t>O mere ka m'bata n'ulo manya-vine,</t> <t>Ọkọlọtọ-ya n'elum bu kwa ihu-n'anya.</t>
<t>Werenu mbadamba nkpuru-vine amiri ami b͕am ume, werenu nkpuru-osisi apple me ka arum di ike:</t> <t>N'ihi na onye nāria ọria ihu-n'anya ka m'bu.</t>

<t>Unu umu-ndinyom Jerusalem,</t> <t>Ejim nne-mb͕ada nile, ejikwam nne-ele ọhia nile, b͕a unu iyi,</t> <t>Unu akpọtela, unu eme-kwa-la ka ihu-n'anya teta, ma ọli,</t> <t>Rue mb͕e ọ gātọ ya utọ. <pb/></t>
<t>Ọ bu olu onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ! le kwa, ọ nābia,</t> <t>Nāmali elu n'elu ugwu nile, nāwuli elu n'elu ugwu ntà nile.</t>
<t>Onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ yiri mb͕ada ma-ọbu nwa-ele:</t> <t>Le kwa, ọ nēguzo n'azu mb͕idi-ayi,</t> <t>Ọ nēsi na window nile lebata anya,</t> <t>Anya-ya nēsi n'oghere-inara-ifufe nwubata.</t>
<t>Onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ zara, sim,</t> <t>Bilie, eyìm, onye nkem nke mara nma, bia.</t>
<t>N'ihi na, le, mb͕e oyi agabigawo,</t> <t>Oké miri-ozuzo agawo, ọ lawo;</t>
<t>Ahuwo okoko-ọhia anya n'ala;</t> <t>Mb͕e abù ọma nke umu-nnunu eruwo,</t> <t>Anuwo kwa olu nduru n'ala-ayi;</t>
<t>Osisi fig achawo nkpuru fig-ya nāchaghi acha,</t> <t>Osisi vine nile nāb͕awa okoko,</t> <t>Ha esìpuwo ísì utọ ha.</t> <t>Bilie, eyìm, onye nkem nke mara nma, bia.</t>
<t>Gi ndurum, nke di na nb͕awa nkume di elu, n'ebe-nzuzo nke ebe di nkputankpu,</t> <t>Me ka m'hu iru-gi, me ka m'nu olu-gi;</t> <t>N'ihi na olu-gi nātọ utọ, iru-gi ma-kwa-ra nma.</t>
<t>Nwuderenu ayi nkita-ọhia nile, bú nkita-ọhia di ntà, ndi nēmebi ubi-vine nile;</t> <t>N'ihi na ubi-vine-ayi nāb͕awa okoko.</t>
<t>Onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ bu nkem, mu onwem bu kwa nke ya:</t> <t>Bú onye ahu nke nāzù ìgwè aturu-ya n'etiti urodi.</t>
<t>Rue mb͕e ifufe anyasi nēfe n'ubọchi, mb͕e onyinyo nile nāb͕alaga kwa,</t> <t>Chigharia, gi onye ihe-gi nātọm utọ, me onwe-gi ka i yie mb͕ada ma-ọbu nwa-ele</t> <t>N'elu ugwu nile nke Beta.</t>
